description: This file is a test script for git's diff and text conversion functionalities. It sets up various test cases to verify how git interprets binary and text files, how textconv filters are applied, and the behavior of diff-related commands under different configurations.

methods.name: find_diff
methods.description: Reads diff output from standard input, removing the header lines up to 'index ' and the footer after '-- $/' lines, to normalize diff outputs for comparison.
